title: Starter vs Pro block with the real limits, and the Pro/Growth mismatch avoided
body:
This is a gap I can close precisely, because the pricing facts are already verified. From zedu.chat/pricing on 22 Oct 2026: Starter is ₦0/month with 3 cohorts, 1 workspace and up to 5 teachers/admins; Pro is ₦20K/month with unlimited cohorts and up to 500 students per cohort. From the home page: "No Per-Student Pricing — Scale your cohorts without worrying about per-user fees".

What I will deliver in one Markdown file:
1. A two-column Starter vs Pro block for the space above the final CTA, using only that wording, with the limit stated plainly ("Starter stops at 3 cohorts") rather than buried.
2. A "Need more than 3 cohorts?" upgrade line that points at /pricing, not at a promise.
3. A headline and subhead built on "Run Your Next Cohort Without Limits", checked against the same page so the phrase is used once, not three times.
4. Two CTA labels, Start Free and Start Pro Plan, each with the live URL I have checked.
5. One line on where Enterprise belongs, and a note that the comparison table on /pricing still calls the middle plan "Growth" while the cards say "Pro", so this section does not repeat the mismatch.

Time: one day. Reviewer check: every price and limit matches /pricing today.
